crossRefs.note: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

translations.web: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
translations.bsb: Firebrands stream from his mouth; fiery sparks shoot forth!
translations.kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
translations.asv: Out of his mouth go burning torches, And sparks of fire leap forth.
